chunks.text:
# Churn segment card: Geography = Spain

Source: Kaggle "Bank Customer Churn" dataset (customers of a bank in France, Germany and Spain). Segmentation: Geography. Segment: Geography = Spain.

- Customers in segment: 2,477 (24.8% of 10,000 customers)
- Churned customers (Exited = 1): 413
- Churn rate: 16.7% (overall churn rate: 20.4%)
- Mean balance: 61,818.15
- Mean estimated salary: 99,440.57
- Mean credit score: 651.3
- Mean age: 38.9
- Mean loyalty points earned: 601.4

In plain language: customers with Geography = Spain left the bank at a rate of 16.7%, which is 0.82 times the overall churn rate (lower).

# Churn rate by Geography x active member

| Segment | Customers | Churned | Churn rate | Mean balance | Mean points |

| France / 1 | 2,591 | 298 | 11.5% | 60,810.59 | 605.0 |
| Germany / 0 | 1,261 | 518 | 41.1% | 119,587.11 | 609.5 |
| Germany / 1 | 1,248 | 296 | 23.7% | 119,874.61 | 611.0 |
| Spain / 0 | 1,165 | 272 | 23.3% | 59,616.31 | 602.0 |
| Spain / 1 | 1,312 | 141 | 10.7% | 63,773.29 | 600.9 |
